lines.t: I called your name before the stars were lit
Formed your heart that you might not forget
My words are light, they never fade away
Follow the path I've set, don't stray
Walk in my ways, beloved child of mine
Keep my commandments, let your heart align
Oh, honor my Sabbaths, where peace remains
Rest in my presence
Free from pain
The world may turn, the shadows may rise
But truth will shine when my spirit lies
Lift up your eyes and hear my call
Stand in my word, you will not fall
Walk in my way
Beloved child of mine
Hear my commandment
Let your heart align
In quiet waters I will lead your soul
And still this day I'll make you whole
The seventh day I bless for you
A gift of rest forever true
Walk in my ways, beloved child of mine
In my commandments, your light will shine
Honor my service, your strength renew
Rest in my love
Forever true
